features: Global and Node resource creation/query/clear/resize paths share the owned timeline, constructors and observer registry with stable entry identity and selective clearing.

Full ZigGlobalObject.cpp now compiles from the pin in Home, excluding its external object; its header is pin/native-ABI identical. The existing reduced-realm helper remains separate. JSPerformance.cpp is also owned.
Module-backed constructors are initialized at VM bootstrap/test-realm creation before user code linking.
Weak sweeps return a boolean and timer sampling uses a noinline frame, eliminating the retained enabled-histogram conservative root in the unchanged ordinary lifetime control.
limitations: The final unchanged seven-file scope retains one registered failure: the old zero-argument resource no-op expectation (#874). This scope is not green.

A prior Deno performance execution terminated by SIGTRAP in global-name resolution. Bootstrap initialization is a static defensive correction; the crashed file is excluded from later execution and remains unverified. Sanitized captured diagnostics are retained.

The web performance file includes a historical constructor-crash regression and is excluded from subsequent execution. Constructability metadata is corrected statically without runtime completion credit for that file.

Initial compile errors, stale-executable runs, inert-constructor failure, disk refusal and weak-lifetime failure remain without final passing credit. Final ordinary scopes run against the successfully rebuilt binary.

Automatic fetch instrumentation, remaining native base-class/option semantics and platform coverage remain open in #873/#869; prior ICU contradiction #872, full Bun suite and Release/ASAN/all-platform verification remain open under #66.
